tellagent.note: Runtime copy of the Tell Your Coding Agent text (no secrets)

parameters.name: Version
parameters.label: Version
parameters.help: Component version and tool-surface version

parameters.name: Status
parameters.label: Status
parameters.help: Controller state and error code

parameters.name: Statusdetail
parameters.label: Status Detail
parameters.default: Off. Pulse Open Setup to start the local Setup Assistant.
parameters.help: One short sentence about what is happening (details: Setup page)

parameters.name: Opensetup
parameters.label: Open Setup
parameters.help: Run checks, start the local-only Setup Assistant and open it in your browser

parameters.name: Setupurl
parameters.label: Setup URL
parameters.help: Address of the Setup Assistant while it is running

parameters.name: Enablemcp
parameters.label: Enable MCP
parameters.help: Turn on the MCP endpoint for agents with tokens (only after the local-only check and the preconditions pass)

parameters.name: Suspendagents
parameters.label: Suspend Agents
parameters.help: Kill switch: reject every agent request, including queued ones

parameters.name: Pairingrequest
parameters.label: Pairing Request
parameters.help: Match code of the pending browser pairing request (not a secret)

parameters.name: Approvepairing
parameters.label: Approve Pairing
parameters.help: Approve the pending browser pairing request if its code matches the Setup page

parameters.name: Rejectpairing
parameters.label: Reject Pairing
parameters.help: Reject the pending browser pairing request

parameters.name: Agentsummary
parameters.label: Agents
parameters.help: Number of agents and paired admin sessions

parameters.name: Tellagent
parameters.label: Tell Your Agent
parameters.help: State of the coding-agent instructions

parameters.name: Copytellagent
parameters.label: Copy Tell Agent
parameters.help: Copy the Tell Your Coding Agent text to the clipboard

parameters.name: Viewinstructions
parameters.label: View Agent Instructions
parameters.help: Open the full Tell Your Coding Agent text in a viewer

parameters.name: Stopserver
parameters.label: Stop Server
parameters.help: Stop the listener

parameters.name: Rundiagnostics
parameters.label: Run Diagnostics
parameters.help: Re-run the compatibility checks

parameters.name: Compatsummary
parameters.label: Compatibility
parameters.help: pass / warn / fail / unknown counts

parameters.name: Port
parameters.label: Port
parameters.help: Listener port. Never changed automatically; changing it stops the listener

parameters.name: Portstatus
parameters.label: Port Status
parameters.help: free / this component / in use by another process

parameters.name: Projectroot
parameters.label: Project Root
parameters.help: Agents can only see and change operators inside this component

parameters.name: Datalocation
parameters.label: Data Location
parameters.help: Project Folder: a git-ignored .tdflowmcp folder next to the .toe (unsaved, read-only, network and cloud-synced folders fall back to private storage). Changing it requires Confirm Move.

parameters.name: Datadir
parameters.label: Data Location In Use
parameters.help: Where this project's audit log, sessions and recovery snapshots are stored (credentials and keys always stay in private per-user storage)

parameters.name: Datastatus
parameters.label: Data Status
parameters.help: Storage decision and anything that needs your confirmation

parameters.name: Confirmmove
parameters.label: Confirm Move
parameters.help: This project was moved/renamed or its data location changed: verify and adopt or copy its audit log (the old copy is left untouched)

parameters.name: Claimproject
parameters.label: Claim As New Project
parameters.help: Treat this project as new: new identity and empty audit log; existing data is left untouched; agents need new tokens

parameters.name: Createprojectmemory
parameters.label: Create Project Memory
parameters.help: Create the optional tdflowProject component (project memory for task checkpoints and handoffs) under Project Root. Agents change it only through TDflowMCP's memory tools

parameters.name: Claimprojectmemory
parameters.label: Claim Project Memory
parameters.help: Accept the tdflowProject's current records as authoritative after a copy, an older save or edits outside TDflowMCP (memory is read-only for agents until you do)

parameters.name: Projectid
parameters.label: Project ID
parameters.help: TDflowMCP identity of this project (saved in the .toe; not a secret)

parameters.name: Loglevel
parameters.label: Log Level
parameters.help: Diagnostic log level
